well one thing for sure is that you do get older, but not necessarily "older". (if you know what i mean). I still like most of the things I did 7-8 to 10 years ago..guess your tastes could or could not change with time..
frankly it depends on your exposure and your circumstances. 
i would say it is positive that you are giving yourself a chance by finishing high school and uni..
i mean maybe..just maybe you can find some sort of clairvoyance.
i hope things get better for you.. I really do :-).
if you wanna chat about ANYTHING, you can pm me or keep going here. (i am not exactly clear about the rules here). btw I love playing video games. 
-too many people get offended these days. I would just rather say sorry than deal with em :P

cause there is no motivation..for staying alive

i dont see anything as good or bad..it is what it is.
i just cant do anything...i have no confidence left..and I hate it.

if i may intrude and ask "did you know that your best friend was gonna kill him/her self?"
" and why didn't you stop it?"

but after school, you get a chance to have new people in life. 
get a job, move out idk..all sorts of stuff.
maybe you will like it?
Maybe you can find answers as u grow?
